summary: Frontend-only responsive testing of /songcoder.html focused on mobile/tablet layout fixes and bad-token publish bug fix. Reset mock first. All targeted scenarios passed: no horizontal overflow at 390x844, 360x740, 820x1180, or 1920x800; mobile-only compact Copy/Start-over buttons visible on mobile and hidden on desktop; fixed publish dock does not cover last field; success modal fits mobile screen; catalog shows 2-column grid (176px 176px) with edit/delete usable; delete works in Go-live mode; tab switch resets scrollY to 0; and the previously-masked bad-token flow now correctly surfaces publish-error-modal with the text 'GitHub rejected the token. Paste a fresh one in Settings.' (no more connect-github-modal interception).
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html is a very large single file (>1200 lines). Not a blocker since it is intentionally a single-file tool, but future features should consider modularisation.
test_credentials: Mock GitHub token: any non-empty string (e.g. 'testtoken'); 'bad' => 401. API base: https://music-catalog-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/api/mockgh
seed_data_creation: Reset mock via POST /api/mockgh/reset at the start of each run. Tests upload one song (TEST Mobile Song by SAVIONCE) in Review (PR) mode and later delete in Go-live mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile layout verified at 390x844 and 360x740; tablet at 820x1180; desktop regression at 1920x800. Dock testid='publish-dock' is position:fixed bottom with z-index 25 and does not cover the last field. Catalog grid at mobile shows 2 columns of 176px. Bug fix for bad-token now triggers publish-error-modal correctly. If re-testing, remember to POST /api/mockgh/reset first.

verification_results.bad_token_bug_fix: publish-error-modal shown with message 'GitHub rejected the token. Paste a fresh one in Settings.' - connect-github-modal NOT shown
